content.short: MakerDAO is the pioneer DeFi protocol behind the DAI stablecoin and has evolved into the Sky ecosystem on Ethereum.
content.description: MakerDAO is one of the most foundational and successful decentralized finance protocols, responsible for the creation of DAI, the industry's leading decentralized, over-collateralized stablecoin. Built on the Ethereum network, the protocol allows users to lock up various digital assets as collateral to mint DAI, maintaining its value peg through a sophisticated system of stability fees and liquidation auctions. As part of its ambitious "Endgame" initiative, MakerDAO has evolved into the Sky Protocol, introducing new governance and savings mechanisms. Governed by the community through the MKR (and now SKY) token, it operates as a decentralized credit platform.
content.meta: MakerDAO is the decentralized protocol behind the DAI stablecoin, providing over-collateralized credit and savings. Discover it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
